output_text:
```python
import json
from azure.ai.documentintelligence import DocumentIntelligenceClient
from azure.ai.documentintelligence.models import AnalyzeDocumentRequest
from azure.core.credentials import AzureKeyCredential

def normalize_expense_fields(document_bytes: bytes) -> dict:
    """
    Normalizes extracted expense fields from an invoice document into a standard JSON schema
    using Azure Document Intelligence prebuilt invoice model.

    Args:
        document_bytes: Bytes of the invoice document (PDF, image, etc.)

    Returns:
        dict: Normalized expense data in standard schema
    """
    endpoint = os.getenv("AZURE_DOCUMENT_INTELLIGENCE_ENDPOINT")
    key = os.getenv("AZURE_DOCUMENT_INTELLIGENCE_KEY")

    client = DocumentIntelligenceClient(
        endpoint=endpoint,
        credential=AzureKeyCredential(key)
    )

    poller = client.begin_analyze_document(
        model_id="prebuilt-invoice",
        analyze_request=AnalyzeDocumentRequest(bytes_source=document_bytes)
    )
    result = poller.result()

    normalized = {
        "vendor": {
            "name": result.documents[0].fields.get("VendorName", {}).value if result.documents else None,
            "address": result.documents[0].fields.get("VendorAddress", {}).value if result.documents else None,
            "tax_id": result.documents[0].fields.get("VendorTaxId", {}).value if result.documents else None
        },
        "customer": {
            "name": result.documents[0].fields.get("CustomerName", {}).value if result.documents else None,
            "address": result.documents[0].fields.get("CustomerAddress", {}).value if result.documents else None
        },
        "invoice_details": {
            "number": result.documents[0].fields.get("InvoiceId", {}).value if result.documents else None,
            "date": result.documents[0].fields.get("InvoiceDate", {}).value.isoformat() if result.documents and result.documents[0].fields.get("InvoiceDate", {}).value else None,
            "due_date": result.documents[0].fields.get("DueDate", {}).value.isoformat() if result.documents and result.documents[0].fields.get("DueDate", {}).value else None,
            "total_amount": float(result.documents[0].fields.get("InvoiceTotal", {}).value) if result.documents and result.documents[0].fields.get("InvoiceTotal", {}).value else None,
            "tax_amount": float(result.documents[0].fields.get("TotalTax", {}).value) if result.documents and result.documents[0].fields.get("TotalTax", {}).value else None,
            "currency": result.documents[0].fields.get("InvoiceTotal", {}).currency if result.documents and result.documents[0].fields.get("InvoiceTotal", {}).currency else None
        },
        "line_items": [
            {
                "description": item.get("Description", {}).value if isinstance(item, dict) else None,
                "quantity": float(item.get("Quantity", {}).value) if isinstance(item, dict) and item.get("Quantity", {}).value else None,
                "unit_price": float(item.get("UnitPrice", {}).value) if isinstance(item, dict) and item.get("UnitPrice", {}).value else None,
                "amount": float(item.get("Amount", {}).value) if isinstance(item, dict) and item.get("Amount", {}).value else None
            }
            for item in (result.documents[0].fields.get("Items", {}).value if result.documents else [])
        ] if result.documents else []
    }

    return normalized
```
